Render a bar chart race to a file

Source: R/race.R
animate_race.Rd

Draws every frame with 'ragg' and encodes them. The encoder follows the file extension: .gif uses 'gifski' and falls back to 'magick', anything else is treated as video and uses 'av', falling back to an ffmpeg binary on the search path.

Usage

animate_race(
  x,
  file = "race.mp4",
  loop = TRUE,
  cores = max(1L, parallel::detectCores() - 1L),
  quiet = FALSE
)

Arguments

x

A ggrace object from ggrace().

file

Output path, ending in .gif or .mp4.

loop

Loop the GIF. Ignored for video.

cores

Number of cores to draw frames on. Frames are independent, so this scales close to linearly. Forced to 1 on Windows, where parallel::mclapply() cannot fork.

quiet

Suppress the progress bar. Progress is not reported when drawing on more than one core.

Value

file, invisibly.
